18 June 2025 (v1.67.6) |feed_title = 🛠️ Skill Tree Update |feed_color = Orange |previous_update = [[v1.67.0]] |next_update = [[v1.68.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.67.3''' is the one-hundred and nineteenth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 13th of June 2025. It overhauled the [[Skills]] present in the game. It has five versions, the main '''v1.67.3''' update (released 13 June 2025) and four minor updates, v1.67.4 (released 13 June 2025), v1.67.4a (released 15 June 2025), v1.67.4b (released 16 June 2025), v1.67.5 (released 18 June 2025) and v1.67.6 (released 18 June 2025). ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Skills]] overhauled. **Refunds given out to players, all upgrades which were discounted will now give back the difference between the older more expensive price and the new cheaper price. ***For Fortify, the last 10 Levels are not refunded as they were removed. Because of this, the maximum refund possible is {{Coins|803,600}} instead of the expected {{Coins|826,460}}. **Restarting [[Skills]] added. 95% of the currency spent is converted into {{SkillCredit|}}. Restarting costs {{Coins|200}}, with the cost increasing by {{Coins|200}} each restart. **Adjustments: ***Enhanced Optics ****Base cost decreased from 9 to 6. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.78 to 1.73. ***Improved Gunpowder ****Base cost decreased from 7 to 5. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.78 to 1.725. ****Explosion radius increase decreased from 0.8% to 0.5%. ***Fight Dirty ****Base cost decreased from 8 to 5. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.78 to 1.77. ***Precision ****Base cost decreased from 11 to 7. ****Exponential value increased from 1.98 to 2.035. ****Starting shots decreased from 39 to 29. ****Visual effects added. ***Resourcefulness ****Base cost decreased from 7 to 4. ****Exponential value increased from 1.74 to 1.75. ***Bigger Budget ****Base cost decreased from 7 to 4. ****Exponential value increased from 1.75 to 1.82. ***Stonks ****Base cost decreased from 10 to 7. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.8 to 1.78. ***Scavenger ****Base cost decreased from 10 to 7. ****Exponential value increased from 1.85 to 1.865. ****Visual effects added. ***Accelerator ****Base cost decreased from 6 to 4. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.8 to 1.77. ***Scholar ****Base cost decreased from 9 to 5. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.85 to 1.83. ***Expanded Barracks ****Base cost decreased from 9 to 6. ****Exponential value increased from 1.85 to 1.86. ****Spawnrate reduction decreased from 1% to 0.75%. ***Fortify ****Base cost decreased from 5 to 3. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.425 to 1.4. ****Levels reduced from 50 to 40. ****Base health increase decreased from 6 to 5. ***Over-Heal ****Base cost decreased from 8 to 5. ****Exponential value increased from 1.65 to 1.7. ****Over-heal boost increased from 4 to 8. ***Bandages ****Base cost decreased from 8 to 5. ****Exponential value increased from 1.685 to 1.7. ***Extreme Conditioning ****Base cost decreased from 8 to 5. ****Exponential value increased from 1.7 to 1.725. ***Beefed Up Minions ****Base cost decreased from 9 to 6. ****Exponential value decreased from 1.7 to 1.68. ****Unit health boost decreased from 0.75% to 0.6%. *Precision Number of
